articles.title_en: Structural identification of weather impacts on crop yields: Disentangling agronomic from adaptation effects
articles.title_cn: 天气对作物产量影响的结构性识别：区分农艺效应与适应效应
articles.abstract_en: A large literature has assessed the impacts of climate change on agricultural production by estimating reduced‐form models of crop yields conditionally on weather and individual fixed effects. The estimates obtained are usually interpreted as the weather impacts on yields once farmers have adapted . Yet, few attempts have documented that farmers do adapt to weather, and none have verified that these adjustments actually impact crop yields. Our objective here is to unpack how weather affects agricultural production by developing a structural model that explicitly accounts for both the plants' biophysical and farmers' behavioral responses to weather. Considering adaptation during the growing season through fertilizer and pesticide applications, our approach allows us to distinguish the “direct” weather effects (i.e., the agronomic impacts of weather changes on plant growth per se) from the “indirect” weather effects via farmers' input choices (i.e., the adaptation impacts). We estimate the underlying structural model using farm‐level data from the Meuse French department, which provides details of fertilizer and pesticide uses by crop. We show that the reduced‐form and structural estimates indicate similar weather impacts on crop yields, for a large range of sensitivity analyses. Our structural estimates indicate that the adaptation effects are sizable and that farmers' adjustments reduce projected damage from climate change. In our illustrative case, farmers' adaptation offsets between one‐quarter to two‐thirds of the negative agronomic impacts of future warming on crop yields. Our analyses exhibit that commonly used reduced‐form models of crop yields inherently capture these within‐season behavioral responses to weather.
articles.abstract_cn: 大量文献通过估计作物产量对天气和个体固定效应的简化形式模型，评估了气候变化对农业生产的影响。所获得的估计通常被解释为农民适应后天气对产量的影响。然而，很少有研究记录农民确实适应天气，也没有研究验证这些调整是否真正影响作物产量。我们的目标是通过开发一个明确考虑植物生物物理和农民行为对天气响应的结构模型，来揭示天气如何影响农业生产。考虑到生长季节通过施肥和施用农药的适应，我们的方法使我们能够区分“直接”天气效应（即天气变化对植物生长本身的农艺影响）与通过农民投入选择产生的“间接”天气效应（即适应影响）。我们使用法国默兹省农场层面的数据估计潜在的结构模型，该数据提供了按作物划分的肥料和农药使用详情。我们表明，对于大范围的敏感性分析，简化形式和结构估计表明天气对作物产量的影响相似。我们的结构估计表明，适应效应相当可观，农民的调整减少了对气候变化预测的损害。在我们的示例案例中，农民的适应抵消了未来变暖对作物产量负面农艺影响的四分之一到三分之二。我们的分析表明，常用的作物产量简化形式模型固有地捕捉了这些季节内对天气的行为响应。

articles.title_en: Agricultural shocks, coping policies and deforestation: Evidence from the coffee leaf rust epidemic in Mexico
articles.title_cn: 农业冲击、应对政策与森林砍伐：来自墨西哥咖啡叶锈病疫情的证据
articles.abstract_en: Deforestation in the tropics is a critical issue that interacts with global environmental changes, and the mediating role of negative agricultural shocks is ambiguous. We investigate the impact of the massive epidemic of coffee leaf rust (CLR) that affected Mexico from 2012 on deforestation. CLR is a fungal disease that negatively affects coffee production. We exploit the gradual spread of the epidemic across coffee‐growing municipalities and estimate a difference‐in‐differences model. We find that deforestation increased by 32% in CLR‐affected municipalities, but we find no increase in agricultural land. We find evidence of deforestation in cropland area, and our effects are driven by states where rustic coffee systems were predominant. These results suggest that deforestation occurred within coffee cultivation areas and point out the concurrent role of government subsidies and incentives through the PROCAFE program, launched in 2014, that promoted the replacement of traditional coffee trees by CLR‐resistant hybrids. We study the dynamic effects of CLR and exploit the delayed launch of PROCAFE to try to disentangle the impact of the epidemic from that of the policy response. Our results emphasize the vulnerability of agroforestry systems to exogenous shocks and suggest that PROCAFE, as a short‐term response to CLR, contributed to increasing deforestation and accelerating the transition of Mexican traditional coffee landscapes to monoculture.
articles.abstract_cn: 热带地区的森林砍伐是一个与全球环境变化相互作用的关键问题，而负面农业冲击的中介作用尚不明确。我们研究了自2012年起影响墨西哥的大规模咖啡叶锈病（CLR）疫情对森林砍伐的影响。CLR是一种对咖啡生产产生负面影响的真菌病害。我们利用该流行病在咖啡种植市镇间的逐步蔓延，并估计了一个双重差分模型。我们发现，在受CLR影响的市镇，森林砍伐增加了32%，但农业用地并未增加。我们发现了耕地面积上的森林砍伐证据，且我们的效应主要由以粗放式咖啡系统为主的州驱动。这些结果表明，森林砍伐发生在咖啡种植区域内，并指出了通过PROCAFE计划（于2014年启动）提供的政府补贴和激励措施的并行作用，该计划促进了传统咖啡树被抗CLR杂交品种所替代。我们研究了CLR的动态效应，并利用PROCAFE的延迟启动来尝试区分疫情与政策应对的影响。我们的结果强调了农林复合系统对外生冲击的脆弱性，并表明PROCAFE作为对CLR的短期应对措施，促进了森林砍伐的增加，加速了墨西哥传统咖啡景观向单一栽培的转变。

articles.title_en: Do obese and nonobese consumers respond differently to price changes? Implications of preference heterogeneity for obesity‐oriented food taxes and subsidies
articles.title_cn: 肥胖与非肥胖消费者对价格变化的反应是否不同？偏好异质性对针对肥胖的食品税和补贴的影响
articles.abstract_en: Preference heterogeneity in food demand has important health and equity implications for targeted and broad‐based taxes and subsidies intended to enhance diet quality and reduce obesity. We study the role of obesity in the purchases of food at home and food away from home using data from the nationally representative National Household Food Acquisition and Purchase Survey. We develop a method for incorporating the complex survey design and retail scanner data into the estimation of a 21‐good Exact Affine Stone Index demand system with endogenous prices and truncated purchases. We find significant preference heterogeneity associated with the obesity status of household members. Counterfactual simulations find that (1) a sweetened beverage tax is effective in increasing the healthfulness of purchases by lower income obese consumers; (2) the nutritional benefits of a fruit and vegetable subsidy are concentrated on nonobese consumers with little improvement in obese consumers' Healthy Eating Index and an increase in their total calories purchased; and (3) a fiscally neutral healthy food subsidy fully funded by an unhealthy food tax benefits nonobese consumers both financially and nutritionally more than it does obese consumers. These findings show that lowering healthy food prices without raising the cost of unhealthy foods is unlikely to reduce obesity. Policymakers in favor of a systems approach of simultaneously taxing unhealthy foods and subsidizing healthy foods should be mindful of the distributional effects of this policy on obese consumers and the lower income population.
articles.abstract_cn: 食品需求中的偏好异质性对于旨在提高饮食质量和减少肥胖的定向及广泛税收和补贴具有重要的健康和公平意义。我们利用具有全国代表性的国家家庭食品获取与购买调查数据，研究了肥胖在家庭内食品和外带食品购买中的作用。我们开发了一种方法，将复杂的调查设计和零售扫描数据纳入包含内生价格和截断购买的21种商品精确仿射斯通指数需求系统的估计中。我们发现与家庭成员肥胖状态相关的显著偏好异质性。反事实模拟发现，(1)含糖饮料税能有效提高低收入肥胖消费者购买食品的健康程度；(2)水果和蔬菜补贴的营养益处集中在非肥胖消费者身上，肥胖消费者的健康饮食指数改善甚微，且其总购买热量增加；(3)由不健康食品税全额资助的财政中性健康食品补贴，在财务和营养方面对非肥胖消费者的益处大于肥胖消费者。这些发现表明，在不提高不健康食品成本的情况下降低健康食品价格不太可能减少肥胖。支持同时征收不健康食品税和补贴健康食品的系统方法的政策制定者应注意该政策对肥胖消费者和低收入人群的分配效应。

articles.title_en: Increasing production diversity and diet quality: Evidence from Bangladesh
articles.title_cn: 增加生产多样性与饮食质量：来自孟加拉国的证据
articles.abstract_en: In the context of rural Bangladesh, we assess whether agriculture training alone, nutrition behavior communication change (BCC) alone, combined agriculture training and nutrition BCC, or agriculture training and nutrition BCC combined with gender sensitization improve: (a) production diversity, either on household fields or through crop, livestock, or aquaculture activities carried out near the family homestead; and (b) diet diversity and the quality of household diets. All treatment arms were implemented by government employees. Implementation quality was high. No treatment increased production diversification of crops grown on fields. Treatment arms with agricultural training did increase the number of different crops grown in homestead gardens and the likelihood of any egg, dairy, or fish production but the magnitudes of these effect sizes were small. All agricultural treatment arms had, in percentage terms, large effects on measures of levels of homestead production. However, because baseline levels of production were low, the magnitude of these changes in absolute terms was modest. Nearly all treatment arms improved measures of food consumption and diet with the largest effects found when nutrition and agriculture training were combined. Relative to treatments combining agriculture and nutrition training, we find no significant impact of adding the gender sensitization on our measures of production diversity or diet quality. Interventions that combine agricultural training and nutrition BCC can improve both production diversity and diet quality, but they are not a panacea. They can, however, contribute toward better diets of rural households.
articles.abstract_cn: 在孟加拉国农村的背景下，我们评估了仅农业培训、仅营养行为沟通改变（BCC）、农业培训与营养BCC相结合，或农业培训与营养BCC结合性别敏感化是否改善：（a）生产多样性，无论是在家庭田地还是通过家庭宅基地附近进行的作物、牲畜或水产养殖活动；（b）饮食多样性和家庭饮食质量。所有治疗组均由政府雇员实施。实施质量很高。没有治疗组增加田间种植作物的生产多样化。包含农业培训的治疗组确实增加了家庭菜园中种植的不同作物数量以及任何蛋、奶或鱼生产的可能性，但这些效应的大小很小。所有农业治疗组在百分比上对宅基地生产水平指标有较大影响。然而，由于基线生产水平较低，这些变化的绝对幅度适中。几乎所有治疗组都改善了食品消费和饮食指标，当营养和农业培训相结合时效果最大。相对于结合农业和营养培训的治疗，我们发现增加性别敏感化对我们的生产多样性或饮食质量指标没有显著影响。结合农业培训和营养BCC的干预措施可以改善生产多样性和饮食质量，但它们不是万能药。然而，它们可以有助于改善农村家庭的饮食。

articles.title_en: The end of an era: Who paid the price when the livestock futures pits closed?
articles.title_cn: 一个时代的终结：牲畜期货交易池关闭时谁付出了代价？
articles.abstract_en: This paper evaluates the impact of the Chicago Mercantile Exchange's (CME) decision to close the livestock futures pits on the execution quality of customer orders. Our findings suggest that, prior to its closure, the livestock futures pit offers high immediacy execution and attracts large orders. Because such high immediacy orders generally execute faster and cost more, their migration to the electronic market after the pit closure explains why the execution of electronic orders becomes on average speedier and more expensive for customers who used to be active pit users. However, our results also indicate that these pit‐user customers face a lower overall execution cost following the pit closure when we account for all their orders, pit and electronic.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文评估了芝加哥商品交易所（CME）关闭牲畜期货交易池对客户订单执行质量的影响。我们的研究结果表明，在关闭之前，牲畜期货交易池提供了高即时性执行并吸引了大量订单。由于这类高即时性订单通常执行更快且成本更高，它们在交易池关闭后向电子市场的迁移解释了为何电子订单的执行对曾经活跃的交易池用户而言平均变得更快且更昂贵。然而，我们的结果也表明，当我们将这些交易池用户的所有订单（包括交易池和电子订单）考虑在内时，他们在交易池关闭后面临的总执行成本更低。

articles.title_en: Social networks and technology adoption: Evidence from church mergers in the U.S. Midwest
articles.title_cn: 社交网络与技术采用：来自美国中西部教会合并的证据
articles.abstract_en: How do social networks impact technology adoption? Exploiting a natural experiment in the mid‐20th century U.S. Upper Midwest, we find that social network expansions, in the form of mergers between congregations of the American Lutheran Church, led to increased rates of agricultural technology adoption among farmers. In counties that experienced a merger, the number of farms using chemical fertilizer increased by over 5%, and the total fertilized acreage increased by over 10% relative to counties without a merger. These effects are consistent with increased information sharing between farmers due to congregational mergers.
articles.abstract_cn: 社交网络如何影响技术采用？利用20世纪中叶美国上中西部地区的一项自然实验，我们发现，社交网络的扩展，以美国路德教会会众合并的形式，导致农民中农业技术采用率的提高。在经历合并的县，使用化肥的农场数量相对于未经历合并的县增加了超过5%，总施肥面积增加了超过10%。这些效应与教会合并导致农民之间信息共享增加相一致。

articles.title_en: Striving to revive pulses in India with extension, input subsidies, and output price supports †
articles.title_cn: 通过推广、投入补贴和产出价格支持努力振兴印度豆类生产†
articles.abstract_en: Pulse production in India has stagnated relative to staple grains and cash crops, raising concerns about rural protein consumption. We experimentally evaluate an effort to increase local pulse production in Bihar. This intervention consisted of 2 years of input subsidies and extension to facilitate learning, followed by the creation of marketing organizations and a year of output price support to raise profitability. Farmers respond to price signals by expanding inputs when subsidized and increasing pulse sales under price supports. However, we see no evidence that the program shifted equilibrium production portfolios as pulses return to pre‐intervention levels after the support ends. Results indicate that short‐term learning by doing cannot overcome long‐run barriers to local pulse production, even when farmers have a viable outlet to sell their surplus output.
articles.abstract_cn: 印度豆类生产相对于主粮和经济作物一直停滞不前，引发了对农村蛋白质消费的担忧。我们通过实验评估了一项旨在提高比哈尔邦当地豆类产量的干预措施。该干预措施包括2年的投入补贴和推广以促进学习，随后建立营销组织并提供一年的产出价格支持以提高盈利能力。农民对价格信号作出反应，在补贴期间扩大投入，在价格支持下增加豆类销售。然而，我们没有发现该项目改变了均衡生产组合的证据，因为支持结束后豆类产量恢复到干预前水平。结果表明，即使农民有可行的销售剩余产品的渠道，短期边做边学也无法克服当地豆类生产的长期障碍。

articles.title_en: Estimating habit‐forming and variety‐seeking behavior: Valuation of recreational birdwatching
articles.title_cn: 估计习惯形成与寻求多样性行为：休闲观鸟的价值评估
articles.abstract_en: Past experiences influence choices, and people's preferences for more similar (habit‐forming) or different (variety‐seeking) experiences are reflected in these choices. We develop a structural estimation framework to capture whether people are habit forming or variety seeking and apply it to the choice of recreation site. This research contributes to the revealed preference literature by demonstrating how to account for habit or variety‐seeking behavior in recreation site choice models in a two‐stage framework. Using this framework, we estimate similarity weights that reflect the birders habit formation and variety seeking preferences. Predicted probabilities from the first stage model are then incorporated into the second stage, a mixed logit recreation site choice model of bird watching trips from eBird, by their members. We find that including the dynamic elements of choice, specifically variety‐seeking behavior, can double the estimated willingness to pay (WTP) for individual sites relative to the static model. Although our sample of bird watching trips taken by eBird members is a sample of convenience, these results suggest that static models of recreation site choice are a lower bound on our recreation demand WTP estimates. We find variety‐seeking preferences are related to land cover and the site's fixed attributes, whereas habit formation appears for seasonality in the bird watching context.
articles.abstract_cn: 过去的经历影响选择，人们对于更相似（习惯形成）或不同（寻求多样性）经历的偏好反映在这些选择中。我们开发了一个结构估计框架来捕捉人们是习惯形成还是寻求多样性，并将其应用于休闲地点的选择。这项研究通过展示如何在两阶段框架中考虑休闲地点选择模型中的习惯或寻求多样性行为，为显示性偏好文献做出了贡献。使用这个框架，我们估计了反映观鸟者习惯形成和寻求多样性偏好的相似性权重。然后，将第一阶段模型的预测概率纳入第二阶段，即由eBird成员进行的观鸟旅行的混合logit休闲地点选择模型。我们发现，包含选择的动态元素，特别是寻求多样性行为，可以使个体地点的估计支付意愿（WTP）相对于静态模型翻倍。尽管我们的eBird成员观鸟旅行样本是一个便利样本，但这些结果表明，休闲地点选择的静态模型是我们休闲需求WTP估计的下限。我们发现寻求多样性偏好与土地覆盖和地点的固定属性相关，而习惯形成则出现在观鸟情境中的季节性方面。

articles.title_en: Land use impacts of the Conservation Reserve Program: An analysis of rejected offers
articles.title_cn: 保护储备计划的土地利用影响：对拒绝报价的分析
articles.abstract_en: The Conservation Reserve Program is the largest agricultural land retirement program in the United States, with more enrolled acreage entering the program through a competitive auction called the General Signup than any other component. In this study, we assess the land use impacts of the Conservation Reserve Program by observing the land use decisions of parcels following the 2016 General Signup. We estimate land use impacts using a regression discontinuity design based on the Environmental Benefits Index, the program's selection and ranking mechanism. Our estimates largely rely on the auction design of the General Signup, such that we observe the land use decisions of rejected offers. We also use information on the rental rates of these offers to understand what the program pays to retire land in different uses. We estimate that a marginal acre of land enrolled in the Conservation Reserve Program replaces 0.30 acres in cropland, 0.25 acres in mixed forage, 0.32 acres in grassland, 0.12 acres in idle or fallow land, and 0.01 acres in timberland. We also find that enrollments from newly offered fields are more likely to displace cropland and less likely to displace grassland than returning fields. Consequently, we estimate that new enrollments lead to 47% greater reductions in water‐driven erosion and 12% greater reductions in wind‐driven erosion, compared to fields with prior enrollment.
articles.abstract_cn: 保护储备计划是美国最大的农业土地休耕计划，通过称为一般注册的竞争性拍卖进入该计划的注册面积比任何其他组成部分都多。在本研究中，我们通过观察2016年一般注册后地块的土地利用决策来评估保护储备计划的土地利用影响。我们使用基于环境效益指数（该计划的选择和排名机制）的断点回归设计来估计土地利用影响。我们的估计主要依赖于一般注册的拍卖设计，因此我们观察到了被拒绝报价的土地利用决策。我们还利用这些报价的租金率信息来了解该计划为不同用途的土地休耕所支付的费用。我们估计，保护储备计划中每增加一英亩土地，将替代0.30英亩的耕地、0.25英亩的混合饲草地、0.32英亩的草地、0.12英亩的闲置或休耕地以及0.01英亩的林地。我们还发现，新提供的地块的注册比返回的地块更可能替代耕地，而不太可能替代草地。因此，我们估计，与先前注册的地块相比，新注册导致水蚀减少47%，风蚀减少12%。

articles.title_en: Farm‐level responses to weather trends: A structural model
articles.title_cn: 农场对天气趋势的响应：一个结构模型
articles.abstract_en: Assessing the effects of weather and climate on agricultural production is crucial for designing policies related to climate change adaptation and mitigation. A large body of literature has identified the detrimental effects of climate change on crop yields worldwide, and farm‐level adaptation has been shown to mitigate the adverse effects on agricultural production. In this study, we employ a structural model to examine farm production responses to ongoing weather trends. We investigate how farmers adjust output and input decisions by estimating a system of output supply and input demand functions, controlling for nonrandom crop selection. Using panel data with 14,796 observations reflecting 1638 German crop farms (1996–2019), we find that both the expected and realized weather determine farmers' production decisions. In the event of a drought, the supply of most considered crops and the demand for fertilizer decrease. The drought shock has also lasting effects on farmers' production decisions, with a reduced supply of protein crops and an increased level of root crops production in subsequent years. These findings highlight the need to account for farm‐level production responses when assessing weather and climate impacts.
articles.abstract_cn: 评估天气和气候对农业生产的影响对于设计气候变化适应和减缓政策至关重要。大量文献已识别出气候变化对全球作物产量的不利影响，并且农场层面的适应已被证明能减轻对农业生产的不利影响。在本研究中，我们采用结构模型来考察农场生产对持续天气趋势的响应。通过估计产出供给和投入需求函数系统，并控制非随机作物选择，我们研究了农民如何调整产出和投入决策。利用包含14,796个观测值、反映1,638个德国作物农场（1996-2019年）的面板数据，我们发现预期和实际天气都决定农民的生产决策。在干旱事件中，大多数考虑作物的供给和化肥需求减少。干旱冲击还对农民的生产决策产生持久影响，表现为随后几年蛋白质作物供给减少和块根作物产量增加。这些发现强调了在评估天气和气候影响时需要考虑农场层面的生产响应。

articles.title_en: Market power in California's water market
articles.title_cn: 加州水市场中的市场势力
articles.abstract_en: We estimate market power in California's surface water market. Market power may distort the potential welfare gains from water marketing. We use a Nash‐Cournot model and derive a closed‐form solution for the extent of market power in a water market setting. We then use this solution to estimate market power in a newly assembled dataset on California's water economy. We show that, under the assumptions of the Nash‐Cournot model, market power in this thin market is limited.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们估算了加州地表水市场中的市场势力。市场势力可能会扭曲水市场潜在的福利收益。我们使用纳什-古诺模型，并推导出水市场环境中市场势力程度的闭式解。然后，我们利用这一解来估算一个新汇编的加州水经济数据集中的市场势力。我们表明，在纳什-古诺模型的假设下，这个薄市场中的市场势力是有限的。

articles.title_en: Land competition and welfare effects from Mexico's proposal to ban genetically engineered corn
articles.title_cn: 土地竞争与墨西哥禁止转基因玉米提案的福利效应
articles.abstract_en: Since joining the North American Free Trade Agreement, Mexico has increased its meat production and exports and become more dependent on imported feedstuffs such as genetically engineered (GE) corn. Mexico recently banned the use of GE corn in corn‐based foods and called for a gradual substitution away from the use of GE corn for other uses (e.g., feed). This paper considers how a complete ban on GE corn might affect Mexican households using a computable general equilibrium (CGE) model to simulate the impact over the medium run (5 years). Results indicate that Mexico decreases corn imports by 76.9% and increases corn production by 65.6%—an increase that would require 3.3 million hectares more land for corn. The policy leads to a 24.8% increase in Mexico's corn price and up to a 6% increase in the prices of other agricultural products. But Mexico might have difficulty shifting land to corn; as such, we consider an alternative scenario that restricts land movements. We find that impacts are further exacerbated in this scenario—for example, corn prices triple. Our final contribution is to pair these results with a compensating variation calculation based on the almost ideal demand system. We find that Mexican households would need to spend, on average, between 6.7 and 13.9% more on food, depending on the scenario, to compensate for the resulting price escalations. Ultimately, our results show that a move toward greater food sovereignty in Mexico is ultimately borne by consumers via higher food prices.
articles.abstract_cn: 自加入北美自由贸易协定以来，墨西哥增加了肉类生产和出口，并更加依赖进口饲料，如转基因玉米。墨西哥最近禁止在玉米类食品中使用转基因玉米，并呼吁逐步替代其他用途（如饲料）中的转基因玉米。本文使用可计算一般均衡模型模拟中期（5年）影响，考虑全面禁止转基因玉米可能对墨西哥家庭产生的影响。结果表明，墨西哥玉米进口减少76.9%，玉米产量增加65.6%——这一增长需要额外3.3万公顷土地用于玉米种植。该政策导致墨西哥玉米价格上涨24.8%，其他农产品价格最多上涨6%。但墨西哥可能难以将土地转向玉米种植；因此，我们考虑了一个限制土地流动的替代情景。我们发现，在此情景下影响进一步加剧——例如，玉米价格翻三倍。我们的最终贡献是将这些结果与基于几乎理想需求系统的补偿变差计算相结合。我们发现，墨西哥家庭平均需要多支出6.7至13.9%的食品费用，具体取决于情景，以补偿由此产生的价格上涨。最终，我们的结果表明，墨西哥走向更高粮食主权的举措最终由消费者通过更高的食品价格承担。
